sentences.l2: 快时尚依赖不断更新的流行趋势和低价促销，使衣柜在短时间内充满新品，也容易让人陷入消费主义的循环。
sentences.l1: Fast fashion relies on constantly updated trends and low-price promotions, filling a wardrobe with new items in a short time, and it also easily leads people into a cycle of consumerism.

sentences.l2: 许多衣服只穿几次，就因为款式过时、面料单薄或质量不佳而被搁置。
sentences.l1: Many clothes are worn only a few times before being set aside because the style is outdated, the fabric is thin, or the quality is poor.

sentences.l2: 相比之下，“少买但买好”强调选择耐穿、合身且易于搭配的衣物。
sentences.l1: By contrast, “buy less but buy better” emphasizes choosing clothing that is durable, well-fitting, and easy to match.

sentences.l2: 它不追求数量，而重视质量、做工与长期使用的价值。
sentences.l1: It does not pursue quantity, but values quality, craftsmanship, and long-term usage value.

sentences.l2: 践行断舍离的人会更谨慎地整理衣柜，只保留真正需要、经常穿着的东西。
sentences.l1: People who practice decluttering will tidy their wardrobes more carefully, keeping only the things they truly need and often wear.

sentences.l2: 这样的方式既能减少浪费，也能让个人风格更清晰稳定。
sentences.l1: This approach can both reduce waste and make one's personal style clearer and more stable.

sentences.l2: 虽然初期花费可能更高，但购买经典款通常更经济，也更符合可持续生活理念。
sentences.l1: Although the initial cost may be higher, buying classic styles is usually more economical and also better fits the idea of sustainable living.
